summary: This change passes. The change producer brief (crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/producer.md) now has the requested rule: each behavior change needs at least one test through the real call site, meaning the existing fake agent driver or nested-run harness where needed, that would fail if the production call were deleted. A test of a helper alone does not count, and the producer must name that test in its report. A new unit test, producer_brief_requires_a_real_call_site_test_and_names_it, reads the embedded prompt through Change.producer_section() and checks for four key phrases. None of those phrases was in the old prompt, so removing the new text would make the test fail. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cap-change` (3 passed) and the budget test (the change producer prompt is about 1245 of its 1300 tokens). fmt, clippy and the full test suite passed in Athena's recorded CI run. The other two changed files, CHANGELOG.md and a new decision D166 in docs/decisions.md, are on the expected deliverables list. Nothing from the dropped job 20261026-170042-cgq9 was brought back. The only finding is a nit: the prompt's version number was not bumped, which matches how the repository already treats prompt versions.
